bull.t: Rapid revenue growth and raised outlook
bull.b: Sustained high growth, a 20-quarter beat-and-raise streak, and increased full-year guidance indicate strong demand and execution. Continued expansion supports greater operating scale, deeper enterprise relationships, and a larger base for recurring platform and campaign revenue.

bull.t: Strong cash generation and improving margins
bull.b: Robust free cash flow alongside expanding adjusted EBITDA margins shows that Zeta is converting growth into financial resources. This supports product investment, debt management, acquisitions, and other strategic priorities while reducing reliance on external capital.

Higher retention among AI adopters and rising superscaled customer counts suggest that Zeta’s platform becomes more valuable as clients broaden usage. Deeper adoption across use cases and channels can support durable expansion in customer spend and recurring revenue.

bear.b: Zeta has improved materially but has not yet established consistently positive GAAP profitability. Thin operating earnings leave less protection against cost increases or execution setbacks, making durable bottom-line performance dependent on continued scale and disciplined spending.

Greater exposure to social channels and agency-led activity can dilute gross margin relative to other offerings. If this mix persists as growth continues, it may limit margin expansion and require stronger operating leverage elsewhere to sustain profitability improvement.

The gap between reported and organic growth shows that acquisitions contribute materially to the current trajectory. Zeta must continue integrating purchases and generating internal expansion to demonstrate that its underlying platform demand can sustain growth without relying heavily on M&A.
